name: Last Wish

name: Iron Guard

name: Craving

name: Chill

name: Teamwork

name: Fragility
desc: At battle start, all enemies halve their HP.

name: Bind
desc: At battle start, all enemies gain 【Stun】.

name: Deflect
desc: Your units gain: Before being attacked, deal X skill damage to a random enemy (X equals the attacker's Attack).

name: Pin II
desc: At battle start, the enemy with the highest Attack has its HP set to 1, and the enemy with the highest HP has its Attack set to 1.

name: New Garb
desc: At battle start, all enemies gain +20 Armor and: When they lose Armor, 【Destroy】 themselves.

name: Deadly Poison
desc: Your units gain: After attacking, give the target 【Toxic】.

name: Ambush Strike
desc: Your units gain: 【Stealth】, and while in 【Stealth】, gain 【Ambush】.

name: Blessing IV
desc: At battle start, all your Pokémon gain +30 Attack and +60 HP.

name: Silver Wind
desc: At battle start / when an enemy unit is knocked out, deal 8 skill damage to all enemies.

name: Self-Destruct
desc: Your units gain: After acting, +5 Attack, 【Near Death】: Deal X skill damage to all enemies (X equals your Attack).

name: Shatter
desc: Your units gain: Before acting, deal 3 【Armor Shred】 skill damage to all enemies.

name: Endless
desc: Your non-summoned units gain: 【Near Death】: Summon 1 initial copy of self in place.

name: Bubble
desc: Your units gain: 【Near Death】: Turn the unit that KO'd you into a 【Phantom】.

name: Savage
desc: Your units gain: Before acting, double HP and Attack.

name: Madness
desc: Your units gain: +1 action per turn; before each action, heal all damage taken and gain +5 Attack.

name: Equality
desc: At battle start, 【Destroy】 the 3 highest-Attack units on the entire field.

name: Moon in the Water
desc: At battle start, all enemies become 【Phantom】s; after any unit acts, they return to physical form.

desc: Your units gain: Before acting, 【Summon】 1 【Phantom】 of self.

name: Dead of Winter
desc: Your units gain: After acting, enemies with no Armor halve their HP.

name: Devour

desc: Choose a Pokémon and return it to your hand. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Easy Money
desc: At end of prep phase, if you have 0 gold, gain 2 gold.

name: Secret Art
desc: Choose a Pokémon: temporary stat gains in the next battle become permanent (3 times per match#HIDE#, used $selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9000708)$ time(s)#HIDE#).

name: Perfect Pair
desc: When a Pokémon is promoted to 4★, gain 1 extra breakthrough reward card.

name: Investment

name: Metamorph
desc: Gain 1 random Ditto. Cooldown: 3 turns.

name: Swap
desc: Trainer HP -1, gain 3 gold. Cooldown: 2 turns.

name: Disguise
desc: Gain your next opponent's trainer skill; at the start of the next prep phase, gain 1 [Remove Disguise] card.

name: Loop
desc: 【Discover】 1 Pokémon card priced at #HIDE#$2+selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9001302)$M0REN$2$#HIDE# (upgrades each use; 5 times per match#HIDE#, used $selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9001303)$ time(s)#HIDE#).

name: Smithing
desc: 【Discover】 1 Equipment card of current shop level +1. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Privilege
desc: The first shop refresh each turn is free.

name: Supplies
desc: After every 2 losses, from shop stock 【Discover】 one Pokémon, one Equipment, and one Event card each#HIDE#(losses so far: $selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9001601)$)#HIDE#.

name: Returns
desc: Choose a Pokémon and sell it at full price. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Echo
desc: Each time you play an Event card, gain 1 gold (max 5 gold per turn#HIDE#, earned $selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9001802)$/5#HIDE#).

name: Nightfall
desc: Randomly gain 1 Event card from shop stock no higher than current shop level. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Research
desc: Choose a Pokémon, remove it, then from shop stock 【Discover】 1 Pokémon card (price +1). Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Arena Edge
desc: Damage you deal to the enemy Trainer is increased by 3.

name: Tenacity
desc: Damage taken from the enemy Trainer cannot exceed N (N is twice the current turn number).

name: Odd Species
desc: Each time the shop levels up, gain 1 【Odd Egg】 (Timer 1: randomly gain 1 Pokémon priced at no more than 3/4/6).

name: Expansion
desc: Choose a Pokémon: its equipment slots permanently become 2. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Balance
desc: Choose a Pokémon: permanently raise its Attack or HP until the two are equal. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Copy
desc: Gain a copy of 1 random Event card in hand. Cooldown: 2 turns.

name: Spy
desc: From your next opponent's last-turn board, 【Discover】 one initial copy of a Pokémon. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Rebirth
desc: Choose a Pokémon: next battle it gains: when KO'd, summon a copy of itself. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Soul Shift
desc: The leftmost and rightmost Pokémon swap Attack and HP for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 turn.

name: Hold Fast
desc: Choose a Pokémon: it permanently gains 【Guard】 or permanently loses 【Guard】. Cooldown: 2 turns.

name: Regular
desc: At end of prep phase, shop upgrade cost is reduced by 1 extra.

name: Battle Spirit
desc: Your Pokémon gain: 【Break】: Permanently +1 Attack and +1 HP.

name: Depreciation

desc: Spend all remaining gold: your Pokémon permanently gain +N Attack and HP (N is twice the gold spent). Cooldown: 1 turn, 2 times per match#HIDE#(used $selfTrainer:getBuffOverlayCount(9003404)$ time(s))#HIDE#.

name: Embers

name: Spark
desc: Passive: When you play a Pokémon card, it gains +5 Attack for 1 battle.

name: Blaze
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field and give it +1 action for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Burn
desc: Active: Trainer HP -3. Choose a Pokémon on the field and give it +N Attack (N is Trainer HP lost) for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Wildfire
desc: Active: At the start of the next battle phase, all your Pokémon gain +N Attack (N is your Fire/Fighting Pokémon count ×5) for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Press the Advantage
desc: Passive: During battle, all your Pokémon gain 【On Kill】: The ally to the right gains +5 Attack and acts immediately.

name: Undying
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon: the first time it is KO'd in the next battle, summon a same-star copy in place. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Crimson Lotus
desc: Passive: When you win a battle, all Fire/Fighting Pokémon on your field permanently gain +3 Attack and +3 HP.

name: Riddle
desc: Passive: After 4 battle wins, Trainer HP +5, then the count resets.

name: Hellfire
desc: Active: Your Pokémon gain 【First Strike】: Deal N skill damage to the nearest enemy (N is your Attack) for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Parts
desc: Active: 【Discover】 1 Equipment card. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Hard Shell
desc: Passive: At end of prep phase, all Pokémon on your field permanently gain +2 Armor.

name: Bounty
desc: Passive: At end of prep phase, gain two random 【Growth】 cards.

name: Eternity
desc: Passive: During battle, after your Pokémon have been hit 6 times in total, all allies gain +20 Armor.

name: Assembly
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field to sell; the leftmost unit permanently gains the sold unit's three core stats. One use only.

name: Melt
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field and permanently swap its Attack and Armor. Cooldown: 3 battles.

name: Good Luck
desc: Active: 【Discover】 1 Event card. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Absolute Defense
desc: Passive: At battle start, your Pokémon's HP becomes 1 and Armor doubles; when Armor is lost, deal N skill damage to a random enemy (N is its current Armor).

name: Keen Edge
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field and give it +N Attack (N is its Armor) for 1 battle. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Coalesce
desc: Passive: Before your Pokémon act, give a random ally +3 Armor.

name: Shadow Kill
desc: Passive: When your Pokémon lose 【Stealth】, they gain +5 Attack.

name: Hidden Form
desc: Passive: At battle start, your rightmost Pokémon gains 【Stealth】 and +5 Attack.

name: Spirit Call
desc: Active: 【Discover】 1 Dark- or Ghost-type Pokémon card. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Drowsy
desc: Passive: At battle start, 【Stun】 the 3 highest-Attack Pokémon on each side.

name: Calamity

name: Shadow Step
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field; it gains 【Stealth】 and gains 【Stealth】 after taking damage, for 1 battle.

name: Exhaustion
desc: Passive: After your Pokémon are attacked, reduce the attacker's Attack by 5.

name: Afterimage
desc: Passive: After your Pokémon attack a 0-Attack target, gain 1 extra action.

name: Corruption
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon on the field and permanently transform it into a random Ghost- or Dark-type Pokémon of the same star. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Pact
desc: Active: Halve Trainer HP and gain 1 random Ghost- or Dark-type Pokémon priced at 6. One use only.

name: Ethereal
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon: at the start of the next battle, it and the nearest enemy both become 【Phantom】s. Cooldown: 2 battles.

name: Link
desc: Passive: When a 【Phantom】 on either side is KO'd, all your Pokémon gain +5 Attack and +5 HP.

name: Mirror Bloom

name: Phantom Lure
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon: next battle, after attacking, 【Charm】 the target. Cooldown: 2 battles.

name: Agility
desc: Passive: Before your Pokémon act, if it is at full HP, permanently gain +1 Attack and +1 HP.

name: Symbiosis
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon; all other Pokémon's HP match that Pokémon's HP. One use only.

name: Pawn
desc: Passive: After a 【Charm】ed enemy Pokémon acts, it is immediately 【Destroy】ed and all your Pokémon gain +5 Attack and +5 HP.

name: Moon on Water
desc: Active: At the start of the next battle, all enemies become 【Phantom】s; after any unit acts, they return to physical form. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Healing
desc: Passive: After your Pokémon act, 【Heal】 all allies for 5 HP.

name: Frost Dance
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon: next battle, after attacking, 【Freeze】 the target. Cooldown: 1 battle.

name: Ice Breaker
desc: Passive: When your Pokémon attack a 【Freeze】d target, that attack gains 【Critical Hit】.

name: Blizzard
desc: Active: At the start of the next battle, 【Freeze】 all enemies. Cooldown: 3 battles.

name: Thaw
desc: Passive: Before either side's Pokémon act, halve Armor; if they have no Armor, halve HP.

name: Trickling
desc: Active: All your Pokémon gain 【Flow】 for 1 battle. Cooldown: 3 battles.

name: Whirlpool

name: Untainted
desc: Active: Choose a Pokémon: it is immune to all negative 【Status】 effects for 1 battle. Cooldown: 3 battles.

name: Confluence
desc: Active: 【Discover】 a Water-type Pokémon card. Cooldown: 4 battles.

name: Great Wave
